sources.institution: Presidency of the Republic of Moldova
Presidency of the Republic of Moldova

evidence.estrutura: Sandu's career includes local-national public administration, parliament, premiership and presidency. Her program emphasizes functioning national institutions and local European-style administration rather than a radical territorial redesign.
evidence.representacao: She founded an electoral party, won competitive presidential elections in 2020 and 2024 and frames her program around democratic institutions and public accountability. This strongly supports representative democracy.
evidence.poder: Her political identity is built around anti-corruption, good governance, rule of law and reform of public institutions. This supports stronger checks on arbitrary authority while retaining capable state institutions.
evidence.imigracao: Moldova's European orientation and large diaspora make mobility central to its politics. Sandu supports European integration and citizens' cross-border ties rather than isolation, though no open-borders doctrine is implied.
evidence.diplomacia: Her presidency is strongly pro-European and uses international partnerships to secure Moldova's development and security. This supports active diplomacy and integration with European institutions.
evidence.intervencao: Sandu strongly defends Moldovan sovereignty amid Russian pressure and seeks international security support while avoiding expansionist military politics. This supports sovereignty and defensive alliance cooperation rather than aggressive intervention.
evidence.economia: Her background at the World Bank and Ministry of Economy, along with reform politics, supports a market-oriented economy with institutional reform, public investment and social support.
evidence.controle: She favors public-sector reform, anti-corruption rules and targeted state capacity rather than extensive command planning. This implies low-to-moderate economic control.
evidence.comercio: European integration and closer ties with the EU strongly support open regional trade and economic integration.
evidence.religiao: Her political agenda is secular, institutional and European rather than clerically governed. No evidence supports religious rule.
evidence.moral: Her agenda emphasizes dignity, education, integrity and European democratic norms. Social positioning is broadly liberal-moderate rather than highly traditionalist.
evidence.tecnologia: Good-governance reform, digital public administration and European modernization support a pragmatic pro-technology stance under public accountability.
